description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bemmulla, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510629 (23/0176)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of titles for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, nature of title, and encumbrances. The content falls under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), with no government personnel or structural changes present.
